item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We cannot accept a future in which national security depends on the permission of whoever controls the most powerful AI.

2. We face a fundamental threat to national sovereignty: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We must act before that power is concentrated beyond their reach.

3. We cannot defend tomorrow’s world with yesterday’s assumptions. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We demand that governments confront this threat now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We must confront that prospect as a direct threat to sovereignty, security and self-determination. We cannot accept a world in which a handful of actors hold overwhelming power while everyone else depends on their restraint. We need governments to put this danger at the centre of AI policy, not bury it beneath promises of growth and innovation. We must demand international coordination, meaningful limits and public accountability before that imbalance becomes irreversible. We have a responsibility to protect our collective ability to shape our future—not surrender it.
